title: bonsai.ladder/1
description: The ladder result (contract §11): the proof that a task's checks passed, at a commit. One JSON document per task at the main checkout's .bonsai/local/ladder/<task id>.json (a --ci run writes ladder/ci.json), never committed. Written by Bonsai's ladder runner; read by the stop gate, verifiers, the statusline, the runner (Bless) and the studio. Today's fields stay; format, workspace and mode are added. Every field is always present, null or [] where it does not apply (contract §2.2, §11); a reader treats a missing field as null, keeps an unknown one (today's rungs also carry exit, output_tail, job and checked) and refuses a duplicate key. After writing, the runner appends a ladder log record with the file's sha256.

format.description: The version, always the first field (contract §2.2, §11).

task.description: The task id the result proves, or null for a run with no task (a --ci run).

workspace.description: The workspace id from bonsai.yaml (contract §3). Today's field: project.

mode.description: local or ci (contract §11). A result whose mode is not local is never a task's proof; a format-0 result with no mode reads as local.

started.description: When the run started: ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds, as today.

finished.description: When the run finished: ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds. Results are cleaned by it (generated.ladder.keep_days).

git.description: What the result proves: the commit, the branch and whether the working tree was dirty, in the checkout the ladder ran in.

sha.description: The commit at HEAD (git rev-parse HEAD).

branch.description: The branch at HEAD (git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD).

dirty.description: true when the working tree had changes (git status --porcelain printed anything).

requested.description: The rungs the run had to climb: the workspace's floor plus the task's bonsai.ladder label (contract §5.6, §11); the stop gate requires each green.

green.description: true when every rung the run took up is green (as today, a rung not built yet that the task does not name reads pending and does not make it red).

rungs.description: One entry per rung of the workspace's ladder that the run took up, in rung order.

examples.name: guard
examples.means: The diff stays inside the task's grants.

rung.description: The rung's number in the workspace's ladder.

name.description: The rung's name from bonsai.yaml ('' when it has none, as today).

kind.description: The rung's kind, a closed list: guard (rung 0, the diff against the task's grants, contract §13), command (a shell command), ver-git (git integrity: records the task's base commit and flags changed test files, assume-unchanged and skip-worktree entries, edits to .git/info/exclude, new stash entries and a rewritten base; spec §9, §16 row 23).

required.description: Whether a red result here stops the run: when true, the rungs after it are skipped. It does not decide the colour: as today, any red rung makes the run red, required or not.

command.description: The shell command a command rung ran; null for other kinds.

means.description: The rung's one-line meaning from bonsai.yaml, or null.

status.description: How the rung ended. Today's values: green, red, pending (not built yet), skipped (an earlier required rung failed), error (the rung could not run). Typed open: the contract does not list them (formats/README.md).

reason.description: Why the rung is not green, as text; null when green.

duration_ms.description: How long the rung ran, in milliseconds; null for a rung that did not run.

tests.description: As today: what the rung's test output showed, or null when it printed no tests. Today's shape: {seen, skipped: [{name, mark, reason}], todo: [{name, reason}]}, plus failed: [{name, file, error}] (the first 50) and failed_count when tests failed. Typed open (formats/README.md).

captures.description: As today: the numbers or text the rung's capture patterns found in its output, by name (null for a pattern that could not run); null when the rung captures nothing.

ratchet.description: For a rung with a ratchet (a count that may not fall): its name, the floor (was), this run's count (now), whether now is at least was (ok), and new_tests; null when the rung has none.

was.description: The floor the count may not fall below.

ok.description: true when now is at least was.

new_tests.description: When the count rose: the new tests run on the base commit (contract §11, spec §9): the base commit, how many new tests, and how many of them failed there. null when no count rose.

base.description: The base commit the new tests ran on.

count.description: How many new tests the rung's output named.

failed_on_base.description: How many of them the base run reported by name as failed while the old tests ran and passed.

skipped.description: As today (under --ci): every test a rung skipped, with its rung, name, mark, reason and whether the skip was accepted; [] when none (always [] in a local run).

rung.description: The rung whose test was skipped.

mark.description: The skip's mark (a <word>-only: prefix of its reason), or null.

reason.description: The skip's reason as the test printed it.

accepted.description: Whether the skip was accepted (pinned with that mark).

leftovers.description: As today: what the end-of-run check found still running from this checkout, or why it could not tell. Today: an object ({checkout: [...], shared_deploy: [...], ms} or {unknown, ms}), a text ("not checked (<platform>)"), or absent (here null) when not checked (a --ci run). Typed open (formats/README.md).

proof.description: As today (under --ci): a sentence saying a CI result is never a task's proof; null in a local run.
examples: none: a CI result is never a task's proof
